title: How we localized the Depot dashboard with General Translation
summary: We localized the Depot dashboard in under three weeks with General Translation. Here's how we moved an existing app over, and how we keep it translated as we ship.
body_markdown: It changes the English characters, adds brackets, and makes the text roughly 40% longer. Unchanged English labels help us spot untranslated copy, and text that gets cut off reveals layouts that need more room. The pseudo locale doesn't tell us whether a real translation reads naturally.
